defect_boundary_exact.narrowed_form: sorted({minimum, midpoint, maximum}) where midpoint = minimum + (maximum-minimum)//2

first_narrowing_location.note: FIRST and ONLY narrowing point on the numeric path; upstream and downstream stages are lossless (see transitions)

native_option_identity: returned int (announceX/getAmount) / List<Integer> (multi) / (target UUID + int amount) (chooseTargetAmount); engine accepts callback return as authoritative

transitions.authority_owner: XMage Rules Core (card/ability implementation computes min/max; engine invokes callback)
transitions.data_fields: (int min, int max, String message, Game game, Ability source[, boolean isManaPay])
transitions.failure_behavior: HumanPlayer: degenerate min>=max returns min; null response re-prompts; out-of-range re-prompts (fail-closed loop, never defaults)
transitions.maximum: engine-supplied max (provenance: card/ability code; per-call UNKNOWN without card-level audit)
transitions.optional_unbounded: no decline path (must return int); no sentinel (no -1 handling in loop); unbounded maxima UNKNOWN per-card
transitions.step_stride: unit (plain int loop bounds; no step parameter in Player interface signature)
transitions.validation_location: acceptance loop in callback implementation (reference: HumanPlayer bytecode)

transitions.authority_owner: XmageFullGamePlayer (bridge; lossless projection, no legality computation)
transitions.data_fields: context {numeric_min=min, numeric_max=max} verbatim; zero options; min_selections=0/max_selections=0
transitions.failure_behavior: failClosed(BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_ERROR) on max<min; failClosed(PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID) on null numeric choice
transitions.stage: native callback -> engine-bridge decision context (XmageFullGamePlayer.chooseNumber, lines 1209-1234)
transitions.validation_location: bridge: bounds-order check + presence check only

transitions.data_fields: decision frame {decision_id, actor_id, decision_class, prompt, min/max_selections, options[], context{numeric_min,numeric_max}, source_object} -> response {selected_option_ids, ordering, numeric_choice}
transitions.failure_behavior: STALE_DECISION on revision mismatch; PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID on wrong actor/forbidden fields/unknown options
transitions.stage: engine-bridge -> protocol decision frame -> Commander-Lab routing
transitions.validation_location: XmageFullGameActionProjection: inclusive-range membership (lines 317-342); requires numeric for numericOnly/requiresNumeric classes; rejects numeric_choice when no bounds authorized

transitions.authority_owner: Commander Lab Lab-side adapter (ExternalPilotDecisionPolicy) -- DEFECT HERE
transitions.data_fields: context numeric_min/numeric_max IN (authoritative); PilotActionViews OUT (narrowed when span>16)
transitions.failure_behavior: fail-closed on missing/reversed bounds, absent/malformed pilot decision; SILENT narrowing (no error) when span>16
transitions.maximum: authoritative max received; interior values discarded when span>16
transitions.native_option_identity: PilotActionView action_id 'numeric:{value}' for offered values only
transitions.optional_unbounded: bounds required (missing bounds raise); no sentinel/step/decline concepts exist at this layer
transitions.stage: Commander-Lab full_game routing -> pilot-facing decision representation
transitions.step_stride: unit when span<=16; {min,mid,max} collapse when span>16

transitions.authority_owner: Commander Lab pilot (strategy only; no legality role)
transitions.decision_class: all (via BasePilot.choose_action; no numeric-native method exists)
transitions.failure_behavior: pilot cannot invent values (Lab parses 'numeric:{int}' or raises malformed-decision); pilot shortlist (3-8) ranks among OFFERED only
transitions.maximum: never sees authoritative max unless offered
transitions.minimum: never sees authoritative min unless offered
transitions.validation_location: none (pilot is not a validation point by design)

transitions.authority_owner: XMage Rules Core (final authority: callback return value consumed by engine)
transitions.data_fields: int (announceX/getAmount/chooseNumber legs) submitted via DecisionResponse.numericChoice; target+amount applied via target.addTarget
transitions.failure_behavior: bridge fail-closed BEFORE submission on range violation (projection); engine consumes returned int (HumanPlayer-equivalent acceptance: any int in [min,max])
transitions.maximum: inclusive upper bound enforced at projection
transitions.minimum: inclusive lower bound enforced at projection
transitions.step_stride: any integer in [min,max] submittable (projection accepts full interval; Lab only ever submits narrowed members)
transitions.validation_location: XmageFullGameActionProjection inclusive-range check (bridge) then native return (engine)

unbounded_reachability: UNKNOWN (requires live card-level audit; S6 to record observed maxima distribution)
